name: ai-pr-reviewer
description: AI-powered pull request reviewer for public GitHub repositories

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ai-pr-reviewer/shared && npm run build -w @ai-pr-reviewer/github-client && npm run build -w @ai-pr-reviewer/ai-review-engine && npm run build -w @ai-pr-reviewer/patch-generator && npm run build -w @ai-pr-reviewer/api && npm run build -w @ai-pr-reviewer/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @ai-pr-reviewer/api" "npm run dev -w @ai-pr-reviewer/web"
